engine: Persistent dbm.ndbm key-value database; actual native backend recorded in results/nosql_tests.json
encoding: UTF-8 JSON values; UTF-8 string keys

delivery:<order_id>.value: tracking reference plus bounded event array (maximum 50)

cart:<customer_id>.value: items plus expires_at_unix; application-managed lazy expiry

authority: SQLite owns stock, payments and published base product fields; this store is a rebuildable read projection.
consistency: cooperating processes use advisory locks; no native multi-key transaction or crash-atomic index claim
recovery: reload canonical catalogue; rebuild secondary indexes; JSON export is portable across DBM backends
